groups.sentence: Colleges, schools, departments and programs develop their own AI guidelines or policies suited to their disciplines.
Units such as colleges, departments and programs may adopt their own more specific or additional AI policies, consistent with university policy.
Instructors consult and follow their department, college or school AI guidelines and keep course policies consistent with them.
Instructors may set their own AI rules, and may vary from department policy if the variation is documented.
Colleges, schools or departments may have their own additional AI rules, guidance or expectations.
AI expectations and appropriate use vary by discipline, so they are shaped locally within departments and units.
